operation.summary: A batch of Address Validation API requests in one, each a whole request frisket cannot see.
Feedback about the outcome of the sequence of validation attempts.
operation.description: Feedback about the outcome of the sequence of validation attempts. This should be the last call made after a sequence of validation calls for the same address, and should be called once the transaction is concluded. This should only be sent once for the sequence of `ValidateAddress` requests needed to validate an address fully.
